root_cause: The successor guard already forbade successor creation for non-overlapping main drift, but terminal write/predictive recovery still mapped main-epoch drift to CREATE_SUCCESSOR_FROM_CURRENT_MAIN and the recovery supervisor accepted only one hard-coded writer owner. This produced repeated PR successors, repeated Required/CodeQL fan-out, and lease-head metadata races.
prevention: Main-epoch drift now routes to revalidate-and-sync of the existing PR. A terminal main-sync is admitted only with exact head CAS and zero path/contract overlap. Overlap stays on the same lineage for reconciliation. Premature closure reopens any structurally valid terminal lease, independent of owner naming. Recovery refresh advances Base-SHA, Writer-Lease-Head and Writer-Lease-Main-Epoch immediately.
